From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Tung <sarah.tung@acme-retail.com>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private MAP kickoff — Acme Retail (VPC + on‑prem)

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, this thread will capture the mutual action plan (MAP) for the evaluation of a Private deployment (VPC-connected + optional on‑prem inference nodes). Goal: align owners, confirm network and KMS responsibilities, and agree a short evaluation timeline so we can close before the end of the quarter.

Attached is a first-pass MAP workbook (MAP_v1.xlsx) and a placeholder topology diagram. Please review and fill in the owner column where needed. High-level asks:
- Identify primary networking/VPN owner and secondary contact
- Confirm IAM/KMS reviewer and expected audit requirements
- Flag any on‑prem air‑gap constraints or procurement lead times

Proposed kickoff cadence:
1) Intro / owner call (45 min) — wide invite this week
2) Technical deep-dive (networking + KMS) — engineering + security
3) Evaluation window: 2–3 weeks (P0 tests + perf/KMS validation)

Tentative timeline: start Dec 6, targeted close (decision to purchase/dedicated reserved capacity) by Dec 23. If that works, please add the right people and we’ll lock a calendar.

Attachments referenced: MAP_v1.xlsx, acme-network-topology.png

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | +1 415‑555‑0121

Subject: Re: Private MAP kickoff — Acme Retail (VPC + on‑prem)

Thanks Lauren — this looks good. A few quick clarifications from our side before we schedule: 

1) KMS: Our security team needs to know whether Redwood requires a customer-managed key (CMK) in our AWS account or if Redwood can bring its own key for the private control plane. Also need an expected list of KMS API calls that will show up in our CloudTrail for audit purposes.

2) VPN/topology: The topology diagram is a helpful start but can you confirm whether a site-to-site IPSec tunnel is sufficient for initial testing versus an AWS Direct Connect requirement? Our networking team (infra@acme-retail.com) will decide based on sustained throughput and compliance.

3) Timeline: Dec 23 goal is tight but possible. Procurement will need 7–10 business days for a reserved capacity PO if we choose Dedicated afterwards — flagging as a risk.

I’ll add our security lead (Tom) to the map. Please confirm owners on your side (networking / KMS / escalation).

— Sarah
Sarah Tung
Senior Product Security Manager, Acme Retail
sarah.tung@acme-retail.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, infra@acme-retail.com
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private MAP kickoff — Acme Retail (VPC + on‑prem)

Hi Sarah — quick responses from the engineering side: 

KMS model — two supported flows we typically recommend:
- Customer‑managed CMK (recommended for regulated data): Redwood integrates with your CMK via cross-account grants. Audit events you should expect: GenerateDataKey, Encrypt, Decrypt, CreateGrant (CloudTrail entries). We’ll share a short list of API calls in the next note.
- Redwood‑managed key for POC (faster): Redwood holds the key; customers get audit logs of access but not the KMS key control. Good for early evals but not for compliance signoff.

VPN / connectivity:
- For initial eval a site‑to‑site IPSec tunnel will be fine for networking tests and KV cache behavior. If you need sustained multi‑Gbps throughput and private peering, we’ll discuss Direct Connect in Q2.

Suggested owners (fill these into the MAP workbook):
- Networking/VPN primary: Tom Ellis (ACME) — secondary: infra@acme-retail.com
- KMS/IAM reviewer: Tom Ellis + Sarah Tung (ACME compliance)
- Redwood engineering owner (networking): Sergio Alvarez (redwood)
- Redwood security/KMS contact: Neha Kapoor (redwood)

I’m attaching a short checklist for KMS integration and a more detailed topology image with port ranges.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Private MAP kickoff — Acme Retail (VPC + on‑prem)

Adding a few security items for the MAP: 

- Audit/scope: If you choose CMK, please confirm whether Acme wants key access logs forwarded to your SIEM or if Redwood should retain copies for troubleshooting — both are options but we need to record the choice in the MAP.
- Rotation / TTL: We can support rotation windows aligned with your policy; note that rotation will require a short maintenance window for active sessions.
- On‑prem nodes: if you plan to place inference nodes on an air‑gapped segment, we’ll need a separate checklist (certificate exchange, offline bundle deploy process). That will add at least 5 business days to the evaluation timeline.

Action items for Acme: please confirm the CMK vs Redwood‑managed key decision and whether audit events should be copied to your SIEM. I’ll prepare the SOC/Security artifact list once you confirm.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
